description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes label keys and values, including regex patterns, validation logic, and related constants.

methods.name: IsLabelKey
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a proper Kubernetes label key, including optional prefix and name parts, returning error messages if invalid.

methods.name: IsLabelValue
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a proper Kubernetes label value, ensuring it meets length and character requirements.

methods.name: prefixEach
methods.description: Prepends a prefix to each message in a list of error messages.
